in_hebrew.name: Robinson
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Son of Robin
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Robinson הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. A surname derived from the Middle English word 'robyn', meaning 'robin'. The name became popular in England during the late Middle Ages, when the robin bird was a symbol of heroism and rebirth.

in_greek.name: Robinson
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Son of Robin
in_greek.long_meaning: Robinson είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. A surname derived from the Middle English word 'robyn', meaning 'robin'. The name became popular in England during the late Middle Ages, when the robin bird was a symbol of heroism and rebirth.

in_latin.name: Robinson
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Son of Robin
in_latin.long_meaning: Robinson est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. A surname derived from the Middle English word 'robyn', meaning 'robin'. The name became popular in England during the late Middle Ages, when the robin bird was a symbol of heroism and rebirth.
